insights.headline: September was a heavy month: you spent $1,651.76, about $398.55 more than August, and $496.27 more than came in, mostly because of shopping.
observations: Shopping came to $757.37, roughly five times your $150.00 budget and well above your usual $278.35 a month. Most of it was TechStore Online, with 7 purchases totalling $615.92 that grew larger and more frequent through the month.
Entertainment reached $151.50 across 7 Cineplex charges, compared with your usual $28.59 a month. Some single charges were nearly double the typical $14.42.
Bills & Utilities were $160.56, a bit above your $143.17 average, because one Town Council payment of $84.74 was about double the others.
Food & Drink ($96.41 of $180.00) and Transport ($41.83 of $60.00) stayed comfortably within budget.
Your only recurring payment was Streamflix at $15.98. There were also 7 small fees totalling $2.01, mostly foreign currency charges on overseas purchases.
suggestions: Look back over the TechStore Online orders and pause before the next one. A simple wait-a-day rule could help bring Shopping back closer to its $150.00 budget.
Check the Cineplex charges, and the larger Town Council bill, to confirm they're all expected. Six cinema charges in two weeks at rising prices is worth a second look.
